Coram : ASHOK BHUSHAN*, K.M. JOSEPH
Uttar Pradesh Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950 – ss.130, 131 and 134 – Application filed by Sirdar (tenant) for grant of Bhumidar Rights in respect of three plots along with deposit of 20 times of land revenue – Sale deed executed by the Sirdar next day in respect rights rejected in respect of two plots – Revision application filed by Sirdar challenging the same – Bhumidar Sanad granted to Sirdar in respect of one plot only but after his death – By Ordinance of 1977, Bhumidar with transferable rights were granted to every Sirdar
Decision Date : 08-03-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5040/2008 | Disposal Nature : Case Partly allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
